title: Polynomial-time-uniform circuits for polynomial-time languages
statement: Every language of Boolean strings decidable in polynomial time has a family of Boolean circuits with at most two inputs per gate, such that the circuit descriptions are computable in polynomial time from the unary encoding of the input length and the family accepts exactly that language.
hypotheses_covered: The language belongs to the class of polynomial-time decidable Boolean languages
